method: Single assistant review of all 21 final queries against preselected original units and full question. Explicit errors, ambiguities, scope additions, and omissions are distinct; no single accuracy rate inferred.
control_limit: Manual controls are diagnostic texts, not a formal semantic gold standard. qid591 places the celebration date at the sentence end, which can have attachment ambiguity. Controls were not changed after running.
